marta (devex): Quick note from today's onboarding session: users hit a silent retry loop after key rotation. sampleapp retried on 401 and ended up using a stale org key from keyring.

yoel (sdk): hmm — SDK retry should call the credential refresh hook before retrying 401s. Is the hook implemented in sampleapp?

marta (devex): sampleapp uses the SDK default, which just retries once without refreshing creds. sequence: rotate key locally, first request 401, sdk retries, loader picks org key from keyring, request succeeds under wrong workspace.

tess (platform): so two problems: (1) retry path doesn't refresh credentials, (2) keyring entries still un-namespaced so stale org key can be returned.

yoel (sdk): i'll add a simple contract: on 401, call options.credentialRefresh() if present, then re-resolve token and retry. fallback behavior: if no hook, do not retry auth errors (fail fast).

harry (eng-runtime): agree with fail-fast default. Silent retries causing cross-account writes are high-severity. Also +1 to namespacing keyring tokens.

marta (devex): UX-wise, can we surface a clear message when a retry used a different token than the original attempt? like: `Auth retry used token from <source>; request attributed to <workspace>` so devs see it in logs.

yoel (sdk): added logging: `auth: retry used token source=keyring(ns=org:123) new_workspace=acme-inc` and a metric we can tie to traces. PR: https://git.redwood/sdks/commit/auth-retry-hook-77

tess (platform): we'll also patch the rotate tool to update namespaced keyring entries and write an audit log entry `rotate: wrote key to redwood:project:<id>` so we can trace accidental overwrites.

ops-bot: created issue #2145: enforce credential refresh hook call on auth retries and audit keyring writes. Assigned to yoel/tess.

harry (eng-runtime): extra suggestion: add an opt-in stricter runtime `REDWOOD_AUTH_FAIL_FAST=1` that disables automatic retry on 401s and surfaces explicit credential-refresh errors to callers. safer for integrations that perform writes.

yoel (sdk): implementing both: (A) credentialRefresh hook on retry, (B) default fail-fast if no hook + env to opt into strict behavior. tests for rotated-key scenarios included.

marta (devex): thanks all. i'll update the onboarding guide with a troubleshooting snippet: "If you see post-rotation requests land in the wrong workspace, check keyring namespacing and ensure SDK retry calls credentialRefresh." Closing after PR merge and docs update. :raised_hands:
